concept.literalSynthesis: Keep the recognizable staff identity of Посох королевы пауков (QueenSpiderStaff) and combine its spider-queen and SpiderHiver sentry motif with the golden ichor spray identity of Золотой душ (GoldenShower). The generated presentation remains a staff; its sentry fires narrow golden bolts rather than replacing either parent's identity.
concept.coreMechanic: Use the reusable staff to deploy a persistent, native sentry that acquires visible targets and fires authored golden bolts at a steady interval.
concept.parentAContribution: QueenSpiderStaff supplies the staff and spider-sentry identity, summon damage class, and source-backed sentry facts: its SpiderHiver projectile is marked as a sentry and has a 36000-tick lifetime. These facts inform the deployed sentry, not an inferred minion or egg-throwing AI.
concept.parentBContribution: GoldenShower supplies the golden ichor-spray identity and the authored bolt's magic damage and straight, fast projectile character. Its supplied projectile facts include 10 initial speed, 2 extra updates, five penetrations, and tile collision; no unprovided ichor debuff is inferred.
concept.playerExperience: Deploy a reusable sentry that automatically fires one line-of-sight bolt per firing interval. The sentry is range-limited, can be retired by Terraria's native sentry limit, and expires after its authored lifetime. Active use has a 10-point base mana cost at animation start; the 30-tick firing interval does not charge the player per bolt.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Deploy a spider-queen-themed sentry that fires golden ichor bolts at visible enemies.

realization.description: The generated item is presented as a visible staff, retaining the Queen Spider Staff identity while combining a spider-queen or hive crown motif with a bright golden ichor accent. On accepted primary use, the reusable item attempts its native 10-point base mana payment and spawns one sentry at Terraria's native resting spot. The sentry registers with the native sentry limit and has a 36000-tick lifetime. It selects chaseable targets within 60 tiles when it has line of sight and fires one bolt every 30 ticks. Each bolt uses authored magic damage of 30, travels straight at 10 pixels per projectile update with three updates per world tick, collides with tiles, and has five penetrations. The golden appearance does not apply an ichor defense debuff: no such effect is authored.
realization.playerExperience: Use the staff to deploy a persistent sentry; it handles aiming and firing at visible enemies without further input. Its shots are fast, straight golden bolts, not homing attacks, and walls can stop them. The sentry is subject to Terraria's native sentry limit and its own lifetime. The item is reusable, but primary use has a 30-tick base activation interval and a 10-point base mana cost attempted at animation start; mana is not paid separately for each sentry shot.
